top_2_targets.fit_rationale: 55-year-old organization providing emergency food, clothing, rental/utility assistance, and self-sufficiency programs. Benefits navigation tools would streamline their intake and case management while helping clients access state/federal programs. They operate the 211 helpline, making them the central hub for social service navigation in Ashtabula County.

top_2_targets.outreach_angle: Benefits navigation platform to streamline intake, case management, and client access to SNAP, Medicaid, rental assistance, and utility programs. Reference their operation of 211 Ashtabula and multi-program service portfolio. Emphasize reducing call center volume while improving client self-service access.

top_2_targets.organization: United Way of Ashtabula County / 211 Ashtabula
top_2_targets.fit_rationale: Operates the 211 helpline - the primary resource database for Ashtabula County, connecting residents to food pantries, utility assistance, rent assistance, and social services. A digital navigation platform would complement their call center operations and expand self-service access. United Way provides funding to ACCAA for 211 operations.

key_personnel.name: Patti Andersen
key_personnel.title: Executive Director
key_personnel.notes: Primary decision maker for United Way partnerships and funding decisions. Contact for strategic partnership discussions and 211 technology enhancements.

top_2_targets.outreach_angle: Strategic partnership to enhance 211 service delivery through digital self-service navigation. Position as complement to call center operations, reducing wait times and expanding after-hours access. Reference shared ACCAA relationship and potential for statewide United Way chapter rollout.

outreach_sequence.step_1: Email Alissa Holdson (ACCAA Executive Director) about benefits navigation pilot program - emphasize 55-year track record and multi-program integration
outreach_sequence.step_2: Follow up with Dino Mauri (ACCAA IT Director) for technical integration discussion if initial interest shown
outreach_sequence.step_3: Email Patti Andersen (United Way Executive Director) about strategic partnership and 211 enhancement opportunity
outreach_sequence.step_4: Schedule joint call with ACCAA and United Way leadership to discuss shared service enhancement
